'''''Flotsam''''' was a [[Starhawk shuttle]] owned by [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]]. The primary [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owned by Faal, [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']], was modified so that ''Flotsam'' was attached on the side, rather than the standard [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Faal and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] flew ''Flotsam'' during a [[Mission to the frozen moon|mission]] to a [[frozen moon]] in a [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|remote star system]] containing a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] center.
